AgentEvent.description: Persisted and replayed: add variants and optional fields only.

AttachmentRef.description: Immutable runtime-owned attachment metadata. No source path is retained.

ImageArtifactRef.description: Durable image identity. Bytes are resolved only at the request/preview boundary.

ImageModelView.description: Fixed model input representation; absent means the immutable original.

LlmCallTiming.description: Observed successful stream timing, measured with a monotonic clock.

LlmStatusEvent.description: Informational provider status; never assistant history or model selection.

ReasoningDeltaEvent.description: Reasoning counterpart of `TextDeltaEvent`; the complete `reasoning` event stays authoritative.

RunErrorInfo.description: Safe failure-only context for status notifications and retained errors.

RunMetricsNotify.description: Latest completed model call; emitted independently of diagnostics mode.

TextDeltaEvent.description: Provisional text of one model call attempt. Complete `text` events replace all provisional text of the same `stream_id`. Never persisted or replayed.
